description: Pre-approved verbatim message templates the 24/7 group watch loop may post WITHOUT per-message approval (Tier 1 autonomy). Rules: (1) every template is approved word-for-word by Juan via pull request; (2) the loop posts the template text EXACTLY — no edits, no additions; (3) anything not matching a template verbatim escalates to Juan as a draft (Tier 2). Placeholders like {name} are filled only with the values listed in "allowed_fill".

templates.text: Hola {name}, gracias por escribir. Te respondo por privado en un momento 🙏
templates.use: Acknowledge a question publicly, move detail to 1:1.

templates.text: Buenos días ☀️ Oferta de hoy: {producto} a {precio}. Cantidad limitada. Escríbanme por privado para apartar el suyo.
templates.use: Daily offer post. Prices only from the approved price list (below competition).

templates.text: Ya llegó {producto} ✅ Pueden pasar a recoger a partir de {hora}. Los espero.
templates.use: Delivery arrival notice posted by Sofia or the salesperson.
